title: Optimizing Encoder Circuits of Entanglement-Assisted Quantum LDPC Codes via Beam Search
summary: In encoder circuits built on the stabilizer formalism, the dominant contribution to circuit complexity comes from the use of controlled (CNOT) gates, making CNOT-count reduction a central circuit-design objective. Entanglement-assisted (EA) quantum QC-LDPC codes offer strong error-correction capabilities with structured parity-check matrices, but their practical use depends on efficient encoder circuits and the availability of pre-shared Bell pairs (ebits).
